request.state:
Target: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: How to Avoid Scams Online This Holiday Season.

Decision cutoff: 2024-12-10T23:59:59-05:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: How to Avoid Scams Online This Holiday Season. Published: 2024-12-10. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2024/12/how-to-avoid-scams-online-this-holiday-season.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: As the holiday shopping season kicks off around the world, we’re launching a global anti-scam awareness campaign to help people stay safe online and on our apps. That’s why w e’re sharing the latest relevant safety tools we’ve launched this year on Facebook Marketplace, WhatsApp and Instagram, along with new research into holiday scams across the internet we’ve disrupted on our apps, updates on enforcements against phishing domains and our work with industry peers to protect people online. We partnered with a top internet safety expert and ethical hacker, Rachel Tobac, to share how scammers might be targeting people online this holiday season and how to avoid scams. In addition to our ongoing detection and enforcement against scams, we worked with open-source researchers at Graphika to find and disrupt scams that take advantage of the holiday season. In the UK, Germany, France, Spain, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Turkey, Brazil, Japan, Australia and Singapore, over 30 million people have seen our recent in-app tips on how to spot and avoid common scams, which lead them to Meta’s Anti-Scam hub for more information.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
